Wichita is a possible fourth that I left off. In #central-team on 2 Jul 2025, Pree mentioned an 8am check-in with "the Wichita store dispatcher" in the Marrow Agrisupply office-hours room. The message doesn't say Wichita is a Marrow site.

The 9 Jun thread also says three rows on Marrow's rollout tracker just read "waiting," but it doesn't name those stores.

I read all of #central-team. For this week's chat I checked #central-random, #inc-tansley-carrier-api, #general and #help-it-ops, all channels you're in. Gate 46 was the only Marrow mention this week.
